Summary: Sparkline IDEworks builds JetBrains (IntelliJ / PyCharm) plugins that provide local indexing + cloud-assisted completions for teams with proprietary codebases. They've built an internal indexer and want a model + runtime that can: 
- do sub-50ms completion responses for single-line completions when model pinned to a small, trimmed LLM variant
- stream partial completions into the editor (low-latency streaming w/ partial tokens)
- support local repo indexing that never leaves customer network (index metadata can be pushed to a private inference layer)

Recent activity / timeline: 
- 2026-02-04: Intro call (Diego) — product overview, high-level constraints. Customer: "must not exfiltrate repo contents". 
- 2026-02-11: Deep-dive (Maya, Eng lead Elena) — discussed on-prem indexer architecture, expected qps ~600 completions/min across 250 seats. Fireflies: ff-2026-02-11-8421.

Requirements / constraints (from calls): 
- Must support an on-prem option: index stays local, inference either private (VPC) or fully on-prem for air-gapped enterprise customers. 
- Model/version pinning is critical: deterministic completions for reproducible developer experience and A/B experiments. 
- Low-latency streaming into editor (50ms median request-to-first-token target for completions) for a responsive UX. 
- Cost sensitivity at scale: want suggestions for batching/caching to reduce per-completion cost; willing to trade model size for latency. 
- Strong audit logging and SSO (SAML) required; retention controls for index metadata. 

Customer quotes / POV: 
- Elena (CTO): "If we can't guarantee no code exfiltration we can't ship plugin to our enterprise customers." 
- Product PM: "Model pinning + deterministic outputs are a must for supportability and debug."

POC asks from Sparkline: 
- Private POC image for on-prem indexer + Redwood Private endpoint configured for their VPC. 
- Example kernel/quantization profile for INT8 run of a 7B model meeting latency targets. 
- Integration guide for JetBrains streaming API + Redwood streaming tokens.
